task.description: ISS-0296: complete REQ-133's AC1-6 live-browser login proof. The config fix (correct Keycloak port/client_id) already landed and was curl-verified long ago. Extensive prior attempts hit browser-automation flakiness in this sandbox, NOT an app defect -- two real environment workarounds are already documented in the issue itself: (1) Vite's dev server binds IPv6-localhost only, not 127.0.0.1 -- use `localhost` not `127.0.0.1` in E2E_BASE_URL / any browser navigation target; (2) React 18 StrictMode double-invokes ProtectedRoute.tsx's redirect effect in `npm run dev` mode, causing signinRedirect() to fire twice with a PKCE-state race -- use `npm run build && npm run preview` (port 4173, matching playwright.config.ts's own default baseURL) rather than `npm run dev` for any live browser session. IMPORTANT CONTEXT since this issue was filed (2026-08-23): a sibling session's ADHOC-ENGINE-AUDIT-20260908 successfully got a real authenticated browser session working THIS SAME DAY and found several real downstream bugs from it (ISS-0529 through ISS-0536, all now fixed and merged: CORS localhost:4173 origin missing, tenant-slug bpm-default mismatch, SPA health-check 404s, JSON log formatter crash, sandbox pool flake, wasm_hang CRLF parsing) -- meaning the login flow itself should now actually work end-to-end in THIS environment, since ISS-0529 (CORS) through ISS-0531 (tenant-slug) were direct blockers/corruptors of exactly this login flow and are now fixed. This run may have a real chance of succeeding where the original 2026-08-23 attempt didn't, precisely because of what's been fixed since. Docker services already running: keycloak (port 8082, healthy, up 12 days) and postgres (port 5463, healthy, up 4 days). A persistent backend `mix run --no-halt` instance also appears to already be running on port 4000 (confirmed via `curl localhost:4000/health` returning 200) -- verify this is genuinely serving current code before trusting it; if stale, you may need to restart it. web/dist already exists from a prior build -- verify it's current (rebuild if needed) before running `npm run preview`.
